scope: saved DopplerDC only,16beams x8 fixed range ROI; no claims about unexported spatial region or nonzero Doppler
cell_selection: for each saved range,highest mean absolute amplitude beam in saved full_none calibration_energy; tie lowest beam; same8cells all variants
full_map: all128 cells quality and mean spectrum maps,descriptive only; no HR-based selection or best-cell result
phase: continuous complex128 conjugate principal increments,P2; cumulative separately in each valid STFT segment,linear detrend; no VMD,no HR-guided filters
amplitude: log amplitude fluctuation,linear detrend,identical STFT; separate diagnostic,not replacement phase performance

reliability.baseline: samecell full_none RMS scaled by chirpcount/64
reliability.dropout_threshold: .01 times full_none first256-frame median amplitude scaled by chirpcount/64; shared physical threshold for allarms
reliability.segment_valid: all finite nonzero complex samples,RMS above numericfloor,<=1percent amplitude dropout; no gaps imputed
reliability.original_masks: preserve and recompute original8window x3target masks independently; new128cell masks separately labelled

stft.scoring: segments entirely after calibration,centers from length//2 to1200-length//2 step20,valid reference at every queried sample
stft.amplitude_phase: normalized power within45-150bpm; continuous observation windows,not concatenated standardized windows

time.definition: reference query = frame/20 +offset; not measured synchronization
time.negative: circular shift reference queries within physical60sec record; preserves label marginal but introduces artificial wrap
time.labels: average interpolated reference across same STFT sample support,no extrapolation
time.common_windows: perlength/perrecord intersect finite HR support for all3offsets and4negative shifts; same time centers for allcells andarms; arm reliability coverage reported separately

scoring: panel equal-cell mean over fixed8cells; report percell and original fixed-fusion separately; no selection by score
reference_power: normalized45-150bpm power within +/-one native Fourier bin around window-mean HR; HR only offline scoring
peak: global maximum in45-150bpm on display grid,descriptive; zero padding does not increase resolving power
diagnostics: phase increment percentiles and near-pi fraction
negative label separations vs native resolution

expansion.record_pass: for a candidate: validpanelcoverage>=.9,>=.6 panelcell-time peaks within5bpm of true HR,mean referencepower exceeds EACH4negative controls by>=.01,MAE smaller than EACH control; criteria must hold at all3offsets; no bestoffset
expansion.dataset_pass: same fixed candidate passes>=5of6records; only warrants preregistration of54record validation,no automatic extension
expansion.limitation: time-shift controls may be weak when HR variation smaller than resolution; record separations explicitly reported; failure is not proof of absent heartbeat
expansion.continuation: until criterion met keep training,VMD incremental experiments,and domain adaptation paused
